title: Systematic Evaluation of TabPFN-TS and Chronos-2 for Zero-Shot Heat Load Forecasting in District Heating Networks
description: Software supporting the systematic evaluation of TabPFN-TS and Chronos-2 for zero-shot heat load forecasting in district heating networks. The package reproduces full-year Flensburg forecasts with TabPFN-TS, Chronos-2, and AutoGluon using included public hourly heat-load and temperature inputs. It also provides Flensburg weather-sensitivity runners with coherent ECMWF IFS HRES retrospective temperature predictions, including the fixed IFS inputs and their provenance. The sensitivity comparisons use the corresponding covariate configurations selected in the revised paper and a common matched evaluation period. Representative-week and Multi-Resolution Residual-Correction Forecaster scripts are also included; their input requirements are documented in README.md. The Flensburg example weeks are distinct from the paper's Munich configuration weeks. Separate metric-analysis, bootstrap, PIT, plotting, and paper-writing pipelines, generated outputs, and proprietary Munich inputs are not included. Existing runner metric outputs are retained. Original project code is licensed under the MIT License. Included datasets and third-party materials retain their original licenses, as documented in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and the accompanying metadata files.
